text: morning

turns.content: Morning. What can I do for you today?

text: yo, how's your day shaping up so far

turns.content: All quiet and good on my end, thanks. How's yours going?

text: ugh what a slog of a day, meetings back to back since eight and my brain's mush

turns.content: That sounds draining, eight hours of meetings would flatten anyone. Hopefully the evening is a lot gentler on you.

text: nothing much going on, just sitting here with a cuppa watching the rain

turns.content: That sounds like a nice way to end the day. Enjoy the cuppa.

text: good arvo

turns.content: Good afternoon. Let me know if there's anything you need.

text: I think I'm coming down with something, throat's all scratchy

turns.content: Sorry to hear that, scratchy throats are miserable. Some rest, fluids and something warm to drink should help, and see a doctor if it gets worse.

text: my commute was a nightmare this morning, forty minutes stuck on the parkway going nowhere

turns.content: Forty minutes of standing traffic is a rotten way to start the day. Hopefully the trip home was easier.

text: my brother Callum's been having a really rough time at work lately

turns.content: That's hard to watch, especially when you can't fix it for him. It might help just to check in with him now and then.

text: my sister's been really stressed since the move, she barely sleeps

turns.content: That sounds exhausting for her, moves are a lot to deal with. It's good that she has you around.

text: mum sounded pretty flat on the phone this morning

turns.content: That's worrying to hear. A call back later in the week might lift her spirits a bit.

text: my neighbour Dave's back in hospital, the hip operation didn't go well

turns.content: That's rough news for Dave, and for you as his neighbour. I hope he gets the care and rest he needs.

text: Priya's been so anxious about her exams all week, I don't know how to help

turns.content: That's a tough spot to be in. Often just being around and keeping things calm at home helps more than you'd think. Is there anything I can do on the practical side, like a reminder to check in on her?

notes: Third party; asks one short offer, no tool.

text: my boss is in a foul mood today, the whole office is walking on eggshells

turns.content: That sounds tense. Hopefully it blows over by lunch.

text: my mate Josh just got made redundant and he's pretty flat about it

turns.content: Oh no, that's a hard thing to go through. Having a mate like you in his corner will mean a lot to him right now.

text: that reminder never buzzed, I only knew because I happened to glance at the clock

turns.content: Sorry about that, a reminder that doesn't go off defeats the point. If you'd like, I can look at what's still pending so we can check nothing else slipped.

text: my reminder didn't go off this morning and I missed the bin truck

turns.content: That's annoying, and I'm sorry it caused you to miss the bin truck. I can check what reminders are still pending if you'd like.

text: the timer I set earlier never went off, the eggs are rubbery now

turns.content: Sorry about that, rubbery eggs are no fun. A new timer is easy to set whenever you're ready for another batch.

text: the three o'clock reminder never came through, no idea why

turns.content: Sorry, I can't tell why that one didn't reach you. If you tell me what it was for and when you need it, I can set it again.

text: I got no ping at all for the school pickup reminder, had to run for it

turns.content: That sounds stressful, sorry it didn't come through. I'm happy to see what reminders are still pending if that would help.

text: can you shift my wake time to half six, I've started getting up earlier

turns.content: Your wake time is a Settings page option, so you can change it to 6:30am there. I can't change it from chat.

text: move the bedtime nudge to ten o'clock, twenty past nine is too early for me now

turns.content: The bedtime reminder time is set on the Settings page, so you can move it to 10pm there. I can't change it from chat.

text: have the evening recap land at eight instead of quarter to nine

turns.content: The time the daily recap goes out is set on the Settings page, so you'd change it to 8pm there.

text: no more check-in prompts after seven in the evening please

turns.content: The latest time check-ins can arrive is a Settings page option, so you can set it to 7pm there. It isn't something I can change from chat.

text: I've set up a new push server for my alerts, can you point the notifications at it

turns.content: Which server notifications go through is a Settings page option, so you can enter the new one there. I can't change it from chat.

text: switch to a different AI model, this one's a bit sluggish tonight

turns.content: The model I run on is chosen on the Settings page, so you can pick a different one there. I can't switch it from chat.

text: can you pull that one off my calendar, we're not going anymore

turns.content: Which event do you mean? Give me its name or roughly when it is and I'll find the right one.

text: actually cancel that, it's not happening

turns.content: Which one do you mean, a reminder or a calendar event? Tell me the name or roughly when it is and I'll sort it out.

text: delete the thing I added earlier, plans changed

turns.content: I'm not sure which one you mean. What's it called, or when is it, so I can take the right one off?

text: take that appointment off my calendar please

turns.content: I can't tell which appointment you mean, and I won't delete a guess, so nothing has been removed. Tell me its name or roughly when it is and I'll take it off.

notes: One_shot: say can't tell, no question mark.
